act.label: Law of Mongolia (Монгол Улсын хууль)

hierarchy.note: Chapter (Бүлэг). Numbered with Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3...). Major thematic grouping above article. Not all laws use chapters; simple laws begin directly at зүйл.
Article (Зүйл). The primary structural unit. Numbered continuously throughout the law (not restarting per chapter). Article heading appears inline: '1 дүгээр зүйл. [Title]'.
Paragraph (Заалт). Numbered with dotted Arabic decimals within the article: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 (where first digit is the article number). Per Law on Legislation Art. 28.
Sub-paragraph (Дэд заалт). Numbered with deeper dotted decimal: 1.1.1, 1.1.2. Per Law on Legislation Art. 28.
Clause (Үе). Smallest subdivision; lettered a, b, c. Per Law on Legislation Art. 28.

act.note: The basic unit is Зүйл (article), not section. Article numbering is continuous across the whole law. Inserted articles use alphanumeric suffix convention (needs confirmation from a 2020+ act). Some laws have an optional Хэсэг (part) grouping above Бүлэг — present in the Civil Code and other large codes, absent from simple laws.

constitution.label: Constitution of Mongolia (Монгол Улсын Үндсэн хууль)
constitution.note: 1992 Constitution, as amended 1999, 2000, 2019, 2022, 2023. Six chapters, 70 articles. Adopted by People's Great Khural on 13 January 1992; entered into force 12 February 1992. The 2023 amendment (May 31 2023, effective January 1 2024) expanded the State Great Khural from 76 to 126 members and adopted a mixed electoral system.

frbr.note: Mongolia uses Gregorian dates. Act numbers are sequential integers within the year. Laws are cited as 'Монгол Улсын хууль {year} оны {number}-р дугаар' — exact citation pattern needs confirmation from official source.

numbering.insertion_note: Inserted articles use superscript Arabic numerals per Law on Legislation Art. 28.10: 'Article 5¹', 'Article 5²', etc. Neither letter suffix ('5а') nor hyphen-decimal ('5-1') is the prescribed style.
